audit_scope: Full surface inventory and root navigation reduction analysis

findings.action_taken: Demoted from permanent root tab. Merged as a high-visibility entry section in Discover, a toggleable layer on the Map, and the routing backbone of Plan and Trips.
findings.rationale: A static 154-route directory does not justify 20% of bottom-bar screen real estate for the average traveler. Merging preserves 100% of transit capabilities while reducing navigation clutter.
Gives the active traveler an instant home for today's itinerary, next bus leg, and saved bookmarks without burying active execution inside Profile/Settings.

findings.action_taken: Merged directly into Discover root via animated SearchBar and Filter Sheet.
findings.rationale: Creating a separate full-screen 'Search Activity' duplicates catalog card rendering and creates disjointed back-navigation stacks.

findings.action_taken: Located cleanly in You -> Contributions and contextual check-in buttons on transit route stops.
findings.rationale: Kept appropriately accessible for dedicated contributors without cluttering or confusing ordinary leisure travelers.

findings.item: In-App Audio Voice Turn-by-Turn Navigation Engine
findings.action_taken: Replaced with zero-cost headless deep link handoff to Google Maps / Apple Maps.
findings.rationale: Building a custom turn-by-turn routing engine would require tens of thousands of lines of code, battery-draining background audio daemons, and paid road networks. External handoff delivers superior navigation for $0.00 cost.

findings.action_taken: Replaced with backstack-derived contextual state (Active Trip ID + current route).
findings.rationale: A global mode state machine introduces fragile singleton state and synchronization bugs. Platform backstacks own their state naturally.

findings.item: Wear OS / XR Display Glasses Module
findings.rationale: Avoids speculative scaffolding for smartwatches or XR glasses before phone/tablet core is complete.

findings.item: Live Vehicle GPS Telemetry Tracking Code
findings.action_taken: Strictly prohibited until physical telemetry hardware is integrated into transit agency APIs.
findings.rationale: Prevents writing speculative WebSockets or mock GPS interpolation algorithms that violate truth boundaries.

final_surface_budget.simplicity_assessment: The remaining 24 user-facing surfaces map 1:1 to genuine traveler jobs with zero speculative fluff.
